text:
Fourth grade ranks 3rd in math MCA participation at Harambee Elementary for 2024-25
V. D. Gordon
The Minnesota Department of Education indicated that Harambee Elementary's fourth-grade students ranked third for participation rates in the math section of the 2024-25 MCA MCA.
Among the 132 Harambee Elementary students who completed the mathematics assessment, 43 were fourth-graders.
Test results show that 12% of participating fourth-grade students met mathematics proficiency standards.
The MCA and the Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) measure student progress toward state academic standards and fulfill both state and federal requirements. Assessments include math, reading, and science, with the tested subject varying by grade. The majority of students take the traditional MCA, while eligible special education students may take the Alt MCA instead.
Statewide proficiency rates on Minnesota's MCA exams have decreased since before the pandemic, as reflected by Minnesota's Report Card. Math proficiency fell by over 7% from 2019, while reading proficiency declined by nearly 5%.
| Grade | # of Students Tested | Proficiency in mathematics |
|---|---|---|
| 3rd | 29 | 34% |
| 4th | 43 | 12% |
| 5th | 26 | 12% |
| 6th | 34 | 18% |
The Minnesota Department of Education provided the data in this article. Full source data is available here.
